data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 雨后车站的倾斜伞面
data.description: 放学后细雨濛濛的电车站台外，柏油路面倒映着昏黄的街灯微光。雪菜双手紧握着一把透明雨伞的伞柄，整个人悄悄挨近你的身侧。她不动声色地将整把伞面大半倾斜到你的头顶，任凭自己的半边肩膀和水手服被绵密雨丝浸湿。面对你的目光，少女慌乱地低下头注视着雨水中的鞋尖，耳尖泛起羞怯的绯红。
data.location: 细雨霏霏的电车站台外街角
data.action: 单侧共伞倾斜伞面紧挨身侧，微垂臻首耳红羞涩
data.lighting: 湿润路面反光与复古街灯温暖的漫射光辉
data.camera: 中景并肩视角，伞面水珠滑落与湿润肩膀细节突出
data.promptProse: Standing on a rain-slicked city sidewalk beside a train station at dusk, Yukina shares a transparent vinyl umbrella, deliberately tilting it toward the viewer. The misty rain dampens one shoulder of her dark sailor uniform as she huddles close under the shelter. Blushing deeply with shy, downcast eyes, her gentle devotion is highlighted by golden street lamps reflecting off puddles on the asphalt.
data.animaCaption: Sharing a transparent umbrella on a rainy evening, tilting the canopy forward while blushing with downcast eyes.
